Even in defeat <UserName> was optimistic about his team ""I thought we were unlucky. The team worked hard and I don't feel the performance of the players was representative of the result. With a few more decisions going our way and taking the chances we got it could have been a different story. But that's football."" Only time will tell if <UserName> can inspire his team to pick themselves up from this result."

"A massive game coming up for <TeamName1> and <TeamName2> as they go head to head in the final of the play-offs. The prize at stake for these teams is enormous and both sets of fans of these fierce rivals snapped up the available tickets hours after they went on sale. <ManagerName1> said this week, ""Undoubtedly it's one of the biggest games for this club in a long time, and I feel we can come away with the win having seen the attitudes of the players this past week."" Meanwhile in the opposition camp, <ManagerName2> had this to say, ""Does the pressure affect us? Not really, we're preparing as we have been all season, it's another match for us, just one that has a bigger prize at the end of it."""
